messages:
Rae (marketing): Noticed handful of HS leads arriving unowned since 08:03 PT. Missing enrichment flag so RR gives up. Can ops/revops triage?
June (revops): Checking. HubSpot shows webhook 504s to enrich-endpoint for some payloads. Our router currently expects enrichment on first delivery.
Sam (ops): Quick mitigation: set a temporary grace window and fallback route. Plan: FF change claim_window 120->420s, and route leads without `enriched=true` into `overflow_roundrobin` with tag `routed_via=grace_fallback`. Thumbs?
Toby (sales-eng): Thumbs. Please add a visible HS note "Fallback routed: enrichment delayed" so reps know to proceed normally.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-endpoint 5xx increased from 0.2% -> 8.4% (07:58-08:08 PT). Auto-backoff enabled.
June (revops): I'll create cohort tag `enrich_grace_2837654321` for dashboards and capture time_to_owner.
Sam (ops): Rolling canary now at 5% -> 25% if healthy. Patch: PATCH /feature-flags/leadflow { "claim_window_seconds": 420 }
Rae (marketing): I'll pause webinar nurture that depends on enrichment flags and post short FYI to #sales-ops.
Sam (ops): Canary healthy at 08:14 PT, increasing to 100%. Enrich 5xx trending down to 1.9%. Keeping grace window for 60m then reassess.
June (revops): Incident INC-2026-6123 opened. Postmortem items: make enrich idempotent, ensure HS retries don't lose metadata, and consider longer default claim window.
Rae (marketing): Thanks team 44d. Will update when cleared.
